unit.why: A biographical-hagiographical sketch of R. Moshe of Sambor (his teachers, his book Tefillah le-Moshe, his habit of travelling to tzaddikim, their testimony about him) with no single narrated event, so it is not a story.
unit.boundary_note: Opens the entry (מערכת ג) on R. Moshe of Sambor; the next division (ב) continues the biographical entry with his father-in-law's lineage.
